limits: This is a 30-second, six-scene synthetic clip of static colored shapes. It does not qualify natural footage, OCR, activity recognition, temporal reasoning, audio, or general video understanding.
Several retrieved frames are byte-identical samples of the same static scene. Correct multiple-frame citations do not demonstrate independent visual diversity or motion understanding.
The yellow fixture called a star is visibly petal-like; its qualified pass must not be reported as an unambiguous geometric-star classification.
The negative answer is supported only for the three supplied orange-rectangle frames. Absence in a retrieved sample cannot prove absence across arbitrary unsampled video.

This review inspected stored JPEG evidence and matched its hashes and reported timestamps. It did not independently decode the source MP4, re-measure presentation timestamps, or test native playback/seek.
The reviewing agent saw the manifest and generated answers; this is an independent visual audit rather than a blinded human annotation study.
The original report remains immutable and failed on citation formatting. A fresh application run is required to qualify the corrected parser and frontend citation behavior.
